name: ARE Holdings,Inc.
summary: ARE Holdings, Inc. recovers and trades valuable and uncommon metals in Japan, the wider Asian region and North America through Precious Metals and Environmental Preservation divisions. The precious metals segment reclaims and markets gold, silver, palladium and platinum from sources such as electronic waste and dental applications, while the environmental division handles the full cycle of industrial waste. Dating from 1952, it has its headquarters in Kobe, Japan.
